en: Falkner
My birds have trained in every wind. Let's see if they can catch you now!
Grounded again... but my birds will soar higher next time.
Bugsy
I've learned so much more about bug Pokémon since we last met. Time to put it to the test!
Fascinating... I'll write this one up in my notes.
Whitney
No crying this time, I promise! My Pokémon and I have been practising!
Waaah! ...No, I'm fine. I'm not crying. Really!
Morty
I have seen this battle many times in my mind. Now let us see the true one.
So that is how it ends. My vision was clouded.
Jasmine
My steel Pokémon have grown even harder... Please, let us battle.
You're... still so strong. Thank you for the battle.
Pryce
Winter teaches patience. Let us see whether you have learned it too.
The ice melts, as it must. Well fought.
Clair
I've been waiting for this. My dragons won't lose a second time!
...I lost again. Don't you dare think this is over.
Brock
My rock Pokémon are harder than ever. Let's go!
Rock-solid, and still not enough. You're something else.
Misty
I've been looking forward to this! My water Pokémon won't hold back!
Ugh, you got me again! Next time I'm winning!
Lt. Surge
Hey, kid! Ready for a real shock? Let's go!
Whoa! You're still the real deal. Ha!
Erika
The flowers have bloomed again, and so has my resolve. Shall we?
Oh my... You are as wonderful as ever.
Janine
A ninja never lets her guard down. Prepare yourself!
My training is not yet complete... Well fought.
Sabrina
I foresaw this battle. I did not foresee how it ends. Let us find out.
So the future can still surprise me.
Blaine
My fire's burning hot again! Let's have a battle to remember!
Hah! Burned out again! I'll quiz you next time instead!
Blue
So you came. Don't think I've been sitting around. Let's go!
Tch. You're good. ...Don't let it go to your head.
Chuck
HWAAAH! My fists are itching! Let's settle this!
Ha! You win again! Back to the waterfall for me!
